en: A vintage black and white image depicting a grand, castle-like building with corner turrets and a central tower, perched on a wooded hillside. The building appears to be a large spa hotel or sanatorium, surrounded by smaller historic villas and dense forest. No visible modern elements. The architecture looks Central European, with steep clay-tile roofs and baroque or art nouveau details. There is no legible text on the front.
